title: The Star Iron
text: A fallen star lies in a crater of glass, still warm and faintly glowing, ticking as it cools. Its iron is the best there is, they say. The grass around the crater has grown twisted and strange, and the air hums.

options.label: Cut the fallen star; iron like this comes once in a lifetime.

outcomes.text: Star iron is heavy as sin. It scars every tool that touches it.

options.label: The wisest studies it first to learn what it really is.

outcomes.text: It is not iron but something else, worth more.

options.label: Leave it; stars should not be cut.

outcomes.text: Its hum softens as you go, almost grateful.
